authority: bounded research contract for implementation; production unchanged

materiality_correction.bound_basis: max(position-wide historical maximum season-equivalent exact lost-fumble target from completed prior seasons, legacy primary-population bound)
materiality_correction.late_qb_restriction: QB cold-start and identity-light fail closed at cutoffs 13-17
materiality_correction.identity_light: eligible only with known/non-conflicting canonical offensive position and matching cold-start eligibility

season_start.week0: explicit omission; no first-party point estimate; materiality-only if eligible and immaterial
season_start.week1: explicit omission; no first-party point estimate; materiality-only if eligible and immaterial
season_start.week2: transition to already-accepted rolling point model
season_start.week18: no new remaining-season rolling point estimate

annual_rollover.mode: deterministic annual refresh plus minimal governed freeze
annual_rollover.rates: recompute cumulative exact position lost-fumble/opportunity and opportunity/game rates through prior completed season
annual_rollover.player_role_priors: recompute cumulative player prior opportunity/game sufficient statistics
annual_rollover.calibration: same global train-only cutoff ratio over pseudo-current seasons through prior completed season
annual_rollover.uncertainty: carry prior floor and widen with newly completed chronology-preserving held-out residual RMSE
annual_rollover.materiality: carry prior bound and widen with newly completed all-population position historical maximum
annual_rollover.annual_gate_failure: no automatic point authority; explicit omission/materiality if supported, otherwise fail closed
